newsitem.title: UK: UK shares firm, cautious ahead of UK rate decision.
newsitem.headline: UK shares firm, cautious ahead of UK rate decision.

text.p: UK stocks nudged higher at the start of trading on Tuesday, taking their lead from a firm close on Wall Street and with Asian markets calmer after recent extreme volatility.
The FTSE 100 was up 8.5 points at 4,116.2 by 0845 GMT with gainers in a five-to-four majority. British Telecom rose after price cut news amd BAA was lifted by positive air traffic figures.
With the FTSE 100 close to its record high, dealers said the market was likely to be on edge ahead of Wednesday's UK monetary policy meeting.
